name: Bramblejaw Understory
introDiscord:
The understory is crowded with slow-moving walls of thorny growth.
Several turn out to be Bramblejaw Turtles carrying entire thickets on
their shells.
introTwitch:
The understory is crowded with slow-moving walls of thorny growth.
Several turn out to be Bramblejaw Turtles carrying entire thickets on
their shells.

bramblejaw-understory-approach.prompt:
Three low paths pass beneath tangled roots. One patch of brambles is
slowly walking away.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp hides a Star Candy cache inside a hollow root. A
Bramblejaw Turtle has been using the root as a scratching post.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests inside a tiny clearing.

Shizuki's note:

'Safe spot because turtle cannot fit.

Turtle disagreed for forty minutes.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. The nearby scrape marks suggest the
Turtle's argument was determined.

forward.message:
A moving thicket stops.

A turtle head emerges.

Then the entire hedge turns toward you.

Bramblejaw Turtle.

bramblejaw-understory-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds shade three understory trails divided by wandering
bramble-shells.

left.message:
A Bramblejaw Turtle occupies the path.

You wait for it to move.

It moves approximately one inch.

Negotiations may take hours.

right.message:
One Berry sits on top of an old bramble-shell scraping.

Shizuki wrote:

'Rode turtle for twelve minutes.

Travel distance: seven feet.

Excellent nap though.'

forward.message:
A shrine coffer rests beneath a root recently exposed by a passing
Turtle. Star Candies acquired courtesy of extremely slow landscaping.

bramblejaw-understory-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp surrounds Thorned Shell Court, where three final paths
wind between ancient shell impressions.

left.message:
An offering basket rests inside an abandoned patch of shell-brambles.
Inside are Star Candies and several extremely determined thorns.

right.message:
A Bramblejaw Turtle raises itself from the path.

The entire hedge on its back rises with it.

There was significantly more Turtle than expected.

forward.message:
Restorative sap waits beneath Shizuki's note:

'Bramble scratches.

Turtle bruises.

Nap stiffness.

Covers all three.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the multipurpose Turtle-adventure medicine unused.

boss-antechamber.name: Thorned Shell Court
boss-antechamber.prompt: The brambles covering the Court begin moving as one enormous mass.

bossPromptDiscord:
The 'hill' at the center of Thorned Shell Court slowly rises.

Roots slide away.

An ancient shell covered in an entire living thicket emerges beneath
them.

Every smaller Bramblejaw Turtle immediately stops moving.

Use /yes to approach the Court or /no to wait several centuries for the
hill to relocate naturally.
bossPromptTwitch:
The 'hill' at the center of Thorned Shell Court slowly rises.

Roots slide away.

An ancient shell covered in an entire living thicket emerges beneath
them.

Every smaller Bramblejaw Turtle immediately stops moving.

Use !yes to approach the Court or !no to wait several centuries for the
hill to relocate naturally.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat. The enormous living hill settles slightly, though calling
it 'stationary' feels optimistic.

boss.revealText:
The thorn-covered shell lifts as an enormous ancient Turtle rises.

Thicket-Shell Ancient reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Ancient settles beneath the brambles again.

Several smaller Turtles resume crossing the path.

Estimated arrival at the other side:

eventually."
